name: ticket-linker
description: Turns ticket references like ABC-123 or #42 into links and context for Claude.

jiraBaseUrl.title: Jira base URL
jiraBaseUrl.description: Your Jira address, for example https://acme.atlassian.net. Leave empty to ignore Jira-style keys.

jiraProjects.title: Jira project keys
jiraProjects.description: Comma-separated keys to recognise, for example ABC,WEB. Leave empty to accept any KEY-123 that is not a well-known acronym such as UTF-8.

githubRepo.title: GitHub repository
githubRepo.description: owner/name that #123 refers to. Leave empty to read it from the git remote.
